konwertuj.podtytul: Video and audio to any format, with full quality control.
obrazy.podtytul: Resize and convert images in batches.
konwertuj.pusto: Your files stay on your computer. Nothing is uploaded.
obrazy.pusto: PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, BMP, ICO. You can drop a whole folder.
strefa.pomoc: Video, audio, images, whole folders too.
panel.format.webp_anim: Animated WebP: a lighter alternative to GIF
panel.rozmiar.pomoc: Bitrate is computed from the duration, encoded in 2 passes.
panel.aac_niski: Below 32 kbps AAC is set to mono and 16 kHz, which sounds cleanest (you can change it). At such a low bitrate Opus sounds much better if the format allows it.
panel.ciecie.pomoc: HH:MM:SS, MM:SS or seconds. Empty = whole file.
panel.enkoder.pomoc: The GPU encodes faster but slightly worse at the same size.
obraz.wymiary.pomoc: Leave one field empty to keep the aspect ratio.
obraz.ico: ICO is at most 256×256 px: larger images are scaled down.
podpowiedz.mono_niski_hz: AAC below 32 kbps: mono at 16 kHz sounds best.
podpowiedz.jeden_przebieg: This encoder targets the size in a single pass: the result may vary a bit, the app re-encodes if it exceeds the limit.
podpowiedz.wymiary_parzyste: Dimensions rounded to even numbers: {w}×{h} (encoder requirement).
podpowiedz.mp3_niski_hz: MP3 below 32 kbps needs a lower sample rate: using {hz} Hz.
podpowiedz.ico: ICO: the image will be scaled down to 256 px.
blad.kodek_wideo: {kodek} does not fit {kontener}. Pick another codec under Advanced.
blad.za_maly_rozmiar: Target size too small for this length: raise the MB, trim the clip or lower the audio.
blad.brak_czasu: The file duration is unknown, so a target size can't be computed. Use bitrate.
blad.kopia_z_filtrami: “Copy unchanged” can't be combined with scaling, fps, rotation, cropping or speed.
blad.pusty_wynik: Nothing to write: the file has no video or audio for this format.
blad.zle_ciecie: The end of the clip must be after the start.
blad.zle_wymiary: Dimensions must be greater than zero.
szacunek.ogromny: very large file: trim it, reduce width or fps
kolejka.podtytul: Jobs run on your computer, several at once.
kolejka.pusto: The queue is empty. Add files under Convert or a link under Download.
narzedzia.brak_ffmpeg: ffmpeg/ffprobe not found. Conversion needs them.
ustawienia.podtytul: Settings are stored in a config file on this computer.
ustawienia.rownolegle.pomoc: More = faster for many small files, but each one is slower.
ustawienia.narzedzia.pomoc: SoraFlux uses ffmpeg, ffprobe, yt-dlp and Deno. They are not bundled: they are detected on your system, picked by you or downloaded from official sources (SHA256 verified). Downloads go to:
ustawienia.enkodery.brak_sprzetu: No working hardware encoders found (NVENC, Quick Sync, AMF). CPU encoding always works.
ustawienia.prywatnosc.opis: Zero telemetry. Files never leave your computer. SoraFlux only goes online when you ask: downloading tools, updating yt-dlp, downloading videos and their thumbnails.
narzedzia.menedzer: Install with your package manager (e.g. sudo apt install ffmpeg)
kreator.opis: SoraFlux needs a few free tools. What you already have was detected; get the rest with one click.
kreator.zrodla: Downloads come only from official releases (ffmpeg: gyan.dev “release essentials”, yt-dlp and Deno: GitHub), with SHA256 verification.
panel.dziesiec_bit.opis: Smoother gradients, but many phones and messengers won't play it
panel.dziesiec_bit.hdr: Keep HDR (10-bit, no conversion to SDR)
podpowiedz.hdr_na_sdr: The video is HDR: colors will be converted to standard range (SDR) so they don't look washed out on phones and in messengers.
podpowiedz.hdr_bez_tonemapowania: The video is HDR and this ffmpeg lacks the zscale filter: colors may look washed out. Get ffmpeg from gyan.dev in Settings.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit: 10-bit output: not every phone or messenger will play it.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit_hdr: Output stays HDR (10-bit). Colors may look different on non-HDR screens.
podpowiedz.dziesiec_bit_niedostepne: H.264 and MPEG-4 are written in 8-bit (almost nothing plays 10-bit H.264). Pick H.265 or AV1 for 10-bit.
podpowiedz.mp4_opus: Opus in MP4 works in browsers and VLC, but older players and phones may not play it. AAC is the safest choice.
podpowiedz.napisy_pominiete: Image-based subtitles (PGS/VobSub) don't fit this format: {n} skipped. MKV keeps them.
podpowiedz.napisy_nieobslugiwane: This format doesn't take subtitles: they will be skipped.
podpowiedz.ciecie_klatka_kluczowa: Cutting without re-encoding is instant, but starts at the nearest keyframe: the start may shift by a fraction of a second.
kolejka.awaria_sprzetu: The hardware encoder failed, finished on the CPU.
ustawienia.rownolegle_wideo.pomoc: Video is heavy on the CPU: 1 is safest. Images don't count.
ustawienia.priorytet.opis: Convert at lower priority: a bit slower, but the computer stays smooth
ustawienia.przenosny: Portable mode: settings, presets and tools live in the “portable” folder next to the program.
aktualizacje.jest: Version {wersja} is available. Download and install now?
raport.opis: The report holds versions, system and recent errors, without your folder paths. Nothing is sent: you paste it wherever you want.
akcje.wytnij.pomoc: Set from–to. Cutting without re-encoding takes seconds and keeps full quality, but starts at the nearest keyframe (the start may shift by a fraction of a second).
foldery.struktura.obok: Results go next to the source files anyway. Matters when you pick an output folder.
info.pokaz: Show info and preview for this file
podglad.brak_pliku: Add a file to see a preview.
podglad.gra: Playing 5 s with the current settings.
pobierz.podtytul: Videos and music from most popular sites, saved to disk.
pobierz.placeholder: Paste a link (or several, one per line)
pobierz.potem.opis: Same settings as the Convert tab
pobierz.prawa: Only download content you have the rights to. SoraFlux does not circumvent DRM.
pobierz.wiek: yt-dlp is {n} days old, sites may refuse downloads.
pobierz.z_path: This is the system copy (e.g. pip). Update downloads SoraFlux's own copy and leaves the system one alone.
pobierz.wlasna_pobrana: Downloaded a current yt-dlp (the old system one is left untouched)
pobierz.brak_ytdlp: yt-dlp is missing. Get it with one click in Settings.
pobierz.brak_deno: Deno is missing: some sites may work worse (yt-dlp recommends a JS runtime).
pobierz.schowek: There is a link on the clipboard:
pobierz.schowek_dymek: Link on the clipboard: check the Download tab
ustawienia.schowek.opis: Detect a link on the clipboard when returning to the window
motyw.wariant_b: big rounded corners, sunset progress bar
motyw.eksport_gotowy: Theme copied. Paste it into a .json file to share it.
motyw.import_blad: This is not a SoraFlux theme file. Check that you picked the right .json file.
motyw.baza_pomoc: Layout and details come from this theme; change the colours below.
motyw.edytujesz_jasny: You are editing the light version. Switch “Light or dark” above to set the dark one.
motyw.edytujesz_ciemny: You are editing the dark version. Switch “Light or dark” above to set the light one.
motyw.kontrast_tekst: Text stands out poorly from the background (contrast {k}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed).
motyw.kontrast_karta: Text stands out poorly from the cards (contrast {k}:1, at least 4.5:1 needed).
plik.blad.brak: This file is gone (moved or deleted).
plik.blad.dostep: No access to the file. Close the program using it, or copy the file somewhere else.
plik.blad.uszkodzony: The file is damaged or is not video or audio.
plik.blad.inny: This file cannot be read. Hover to see details.
kolejka.uciete: The source stops at {czas}, the result is shorter (the file header says {oczekiwane}).
szacunek.zrodlo_kbps: The source has only {n} kb/s, a higher bitrate will not improve quality.
rust.brak_narzedzia: {nazwa} is missing: pick it in Settings → Tools or download it.
rust.ytdlp_bez_sciezki: yt-dlp didn't report the path of the downloaded file.
rust.folder_zapisu: Can't use the folder {folder} ({blad}). Choose another output folder.
rust.menedzer_pakietow: On this system, install this tool with your package manager.
rust.zla_suma: Wrong SHA256 for {nazwa}: got {jest}, expected {oczekiwana}. The file was not installed.
rust.yt.blokada: The site blocked the download. Click Update yt-dlp and try again.
rust.yt.prywatny: This is a private video: it can't be downloaded without access from its owner.
rust.yt.wiek: Age-restricted video: the site requires signing in.
rust.yt.kraj: This video isn't available in your country.
rust.yt.transmisja: The live stream hasn't started yet. Try again once it's available.
rust.yt.brak_formatu: The site didn't offer any downloadable format. Click Update yt-dlp and try again.
rust.yt.drm: This content is DRM-protected; we don't download it.
